text:
Priya (docs): Pulled together a tiny PR that consolidates batching guidance, a KV-prefetch example, and a short-seq quant note. Requesting a quick review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

Owen (eng): Linked. Quick heads-up: the Go snippet still references NewGenCall(), should be updated to the request builder. I can paste the corrected snippet here.

Maeve R.: Also the prefetch example points to /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet which 404s in preview. We should use a relative path and add an anchor.

Owen (eng): Go fix: ```go
req := client.NewRequest().WithModel("redwood/opt-1").WithBatching(true)
res, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
``` Compiles in our samples.

Priya (docs): Thanks Owen. Maeve, can you pick up the link fix and add the relative anchor?

Maeve R.: On it. Also adding a one-liner under "Quantization profiles" recommending fp16 for sequences <64 tokens and only enable 4-bit after passing regression checks. Will include a minimal qprofile example.

docs-bot: TODO created: docs#523: replace internal prefetch link, add short-seq quant blurb. Assignee: Maeve.

Sam: Perf note: from the perf team - interactive UI use 20-30ms batching window; high-throughput pipelines 100-200ms. I'll add numbers to the PR comment.

Priya (docs): Add a tiny YAML showing fallback routing when batching violates SLOs (one small block). Keep it as an example, not normative.

Maeve R.: Draft YAML: ```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation
``` Adding to PR.

Owen (eng): Also updated the JS embed snippet to use "model" instead of "embed_model". Left a short note in the SDK migration guide about that rename.

docs-bot: Preview started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/523. Link check: 1 broken -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet.

Maeve R.: Fixed anchor and changed to ./prefetch-cheatsheet.md#examples. Re-pushed.

docs-bot: Re-run link check: 0 broken links. Build green. Lint: no warnings.

Priya (docs): Approved. I'll merge after CI finishes and add a one-line changelog: "Optimize: batching defaults, KV prefetch example, short-seq quant guidance, SDK migration notes."

Owen (eng): Great, I'll follow up and update sample apps to the new builder API tomorrow.

Maeve R.: Added a translator note for the short-seq blurb. Closing thread. :sparkles:
